excerpt_i18n.en: For general-purpose agents, multimodal interaction is becoming a key foundational technology that significantly enhances user experience. In the past, user interaction with AI mostly involved inputting text, uploading images, and waiting for answers. Now, parents hope to directly point the camera at the problems their children are working on and have the AI explain step by step; in scenarios like outfit recommendations or video navigation for visually impaired people, users also want AI to not just ask and answer, but to continuously listen and converse throughout the task. This change not only improves feature richness but also increases the frequency and depth of user connection with AI. Pei Zhiwei, head of intelligent video technology at Volcano Engine, mentioned during a sharing session that multimodal scenarios such as video calls "greatly broaden the universality of technical solutions and bring more imagination," while also helping Doubao gain more traffic—"almost without much investment, the business scale increased tenfold, from tens of millions of DAU to hundreds of millions of DAU." This multimodal experience is not determined solely by model capabilities. After users turn on the camera and microphone, what truly affects the experience includes transmission quality—whether the connection is fast enough, whether it's stable under weak networks, whether audio and video are synchronized, whether user interruptions can be responded to in a timely manner, and whether the model can obtain the correct information at the right time. Therefore, both Doubao in China and ChatGPT overseas are building a more mature technical foundation that enables natural communication between AI and humans. excerpt_i18n.en: On July 15, Alibaba released the real-time voice interaction dialogue model Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime, simultaneously upgrading across four main lines: IQ, Agent tool calling, empathetic dialogue, and duplex interaction fluency, aiming to be "both fast and smart." The model includes a Plus version with stronger reasoning and a Flash version with faster speed, suitable for scenarios such as intelligent customer service, education and training, entertainment interaction, and emotional companionship.
